skill.name: developer-growth-analysis
skill.description: Analyzes recent Claude Code chat history to identify development patterns, skill gaps, learning resources, and growth recommendations.
skill.summary: Creates a personalized developer growth report from recent Claude Code work history.
skill.author: Joseph OBrien

security_audit.summary: The Ruby backtick findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences and inline code formatting. The real risks are sensitive local file access to Claude Code history and external sharing of chat-derived work details through Slack and HackerNews search workflows.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before reading ~/.claude/history.jsonl, and let users choose the time range and data fields to include.

remediation.issue: External Slack delivery of chat-derived reports
remediation.suggestion: Show a preview, redact project names and secrets, and ask for approval before sending any report content to Slack.

remediation.issue: External searches based on private work history
remediation.suggestion: Generate generic HackerNews queries that remove project names, code terms, customer names, and sensitive implementation details.

content.user_title: Analyze Developer Growth from Claude Code History
content.value_statement: Developers often miss patterns in their recent AI-assisted coding work. This skill reviews Claude Code history and turns it into focused improvement recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Reads recent Claude Code chat history from a local history file.
Identifies projects, technologies, problem types, and repeated challenges.
Prioritizes three to five evidence-based improvement areas.
Generates a structured developer growth report with action items.
Searches HackerNews for learning resources related to improvement areas.
Sends the completed report to the user through Slack DMs.
limitations: Requires access to the local Claude Code history file.
Quality depends on the detail and accuracy of recent chat history.
HackerNews results may not cover every niche technology or problem.
Slack delivery requires an active Rube MCP Slack connection.

use_cases.title: Review Recent Coding Habits
use_cases.description: Analyze recent Claude Code sessions to find recurring strengths, blockers, and learning priorities.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Mentoring Sessions
use_cases.description: Create a concise evidence-based report that helps guide coaching, pair programming, or career discussions.

use_cases.title: Plan Weekly Learning Goals
use_cases.description: Turn recent project struggles into specific study topics, action items, and curated reading resources.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Recent Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a general review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my developer growth from my recent Claude Code chats.

prompt_templates.title: Review Today Only
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused analysis for a short time window.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my coding work from today and identify my top three improvement areas.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on One Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my recent Claude Code history for the current project and create a developer growth report.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Weekly Learning Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that combines analysis, prioritization, and resources.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the past 48 hours of my Claude Code work, prioritize skill gaps, find learning resources, and draft a weekly action plan.

output_examples.input: Analyze my developer growth from my recent chats.
output_examples.output: A report summarizing recent projects, technologies used, improvement areas, strengths, action items, and curated learning resources.

output_examples.input: Analyze my work from today and suggest areas for improvement.
output_examples.output: A focused daily review with the strongest observed patterns, three improvement recommendations, and next steps for practice.

output_examples.input: Send my growth report to Slack after reviewing my recent work.
output_examples.output: A Slack-ready summary split into sections for work summary, prioritized improvements, strengths, actions, and resource links.

best_practices: Review the report before sending it to Slack or sharing it with others.
Use a clear time window so recommendations match the work you want reviewed.
Focus on one or two improvement areas before running another review.
anti_patterns: Do not run the skill on chat history that includes secrets or confidential client data.
Do not treat the report as a complete performance review or manager evaluation.
Do not send the report externally before checking it for sensitive details.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes recent Claude Code chat history, including tasks, technologies, challenges, and pasted content references.

faq.question: Does it need local file access?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill expects access to ~/.claude/history.jsonl to read recent Claude Code activity.

faq.question: Can it find learning resources?
faq.answer: Yes. It searches HackerNews for articles and discussions related to the identified improvement areas.

faq.question: Can it send the report to Slack?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use Rube MCP to send the completed report to the user through Slack DMs.

faq.question: Should I review the report before sending it?
faq.answer: Yes. Review it for secrets, private code, project names, and confidential details before external delivery.

faq.question: Is this a replacement for code review?
faq.answer: No. It supports personal learning by finding patterns, but it does not replace human code review.
